Before midnight, he wrote an answer, sealed it in the bottle, and set it upon the tide.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一只尚未合眼的兽。高架桥托着稀疏的车灯，便利店的白光落在空荡的街口；送奶车拐过旧巷，惊起屋檐下沉睡的鸽群。有人刚结束夜班，有人已经生起炉火，蒸笼里的白气与江面的薄雾缓缓相逢。远处第一班地铁穿过黑暗，窗内每一张沉默的脸，都藏着一场没有做完的梦。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding another box inside; you keep opening boxes until you find the key.\n- Finding the key is the stopping point, and every set of recursive instructions needs one so it does not go on forever."}
